title: SQLite settings repository with WAL, busy timeout and upserts
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag the PRAGMA statements as string SQL without parameters. PRAGMAs cannot take bound parameters in SQLite; both use fixed literal values chosen by this module, while every statement touching user keys or values is parameterized, as the injection-shaped key in the check demonstrates.
